summary: Viatris Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of senior notes due [date] guaranteed by Mylan Inc., Mylan II B.V., and Utah Acquisition Sub Inc. The filing is a routine debt issuance under an effective shelf registration, with terms (interest rate, maturity, redemption provisions) to be determined. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is involved. The offering is a standard capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
